newsitem.title: UK: Britain's electricity Pool approves developments.
newsitem.headline: Britain's electricity Pool approves developments.

text.p: Britain's electricity wholesale market, the Pool, gave approval to a 7.3 million stg development programme, its biggest since creation in 1990.

In a statement, the Pool said projects to be undertaken in the next 18 months included enhancement to its Demand Side Bidding Scheme and new schemes for allocating costs of transmission losses between generators and suppliers.
It will also introduce new schemes for handling undergeneration costs.
It said that the Pool would review its security of supply arrangements in April in the light of gas market interaction over the last winter.
The Pool also reaffirmed its commitment to its 50 million stg 1998 programme, scheduled for delivery in April 1998, when the domestic supply market begins opening up to competition.
